incidents.title: Iran Intensifies Hormuz Tanker Attacks Just as Oil Prices Slide
incidents.description: Iran’s attacks on oil tankers crossing the crucial Strait of Hormuz are getting more intense, just as prices have tumbled due to a flood of supply from the Middle East.

incidents.title: TARA GAS Burning Off Oman as Another Tanker Attack Leaves 11 Injured
incidents.description: The LPG tanker TARA GAS remained on fire and adrift in the Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday, according to a new navigational warning, as independently verified video showed the vessel...
